sql: SELECT sales_date, store_sk, revenue FROM v_daily_store_sales WHERE sales_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - {days} ORDER BY sales_date

SELECT i.i_category, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue FROM store_sales ss, item i, date_dim d WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year = {year} AND d.d_moy = {moy} GROUP BY i.i_category ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT it.i_category AS category, SUM(s.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales s JOIN dim_item it ON it.i_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk JOIN dim_date dt ON dt.d_date_sk = s.ss_sold_date_sk WHERE dt.d_year = {year} AND dt.d_moy = {moy} GROUP BY it.i_category ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT * FROM (SELECT i.i_product_name, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS revenue FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= {n}

SELECT s_store_name, revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT s.s_store_name, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS revenue FROM store_sales ss JOIN dim_store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk GROUP BY s.s_store_name)
SELECT ca_state, loyalty_tier, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM v_customer_360 GROUP BY ca_state, loyalty_tier
SELECT t.t_hour, COUNT(*) AS sales FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim t ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY t.t_hour ORDER BY t.t_hour

SELECT fiscal_quarter(d.d_date) AS quarter, SUM(fn_net_price(ss.ss_list_price, ss.ss_ext_discount_amt)) AS net FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = {year} GROUP BY fiscal_quarter(d.d_date)

SELECT get_qtr(d.d_date) AS qtr, SUM(calc_net_amount(ws.ws_list_price, ws.ws_ext_discount_amt)) AS net_amount FROM web_sales ws JOIN dim_date d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = {year} GROUP BY get_qtr(d.d_date)

SELECT t.store_sk, t.target_quarter, t.target_amount, NVL(a.revenue, 0) AS actual FROM sales_target t, (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_qoy, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS revenue FROM store_sales ss, date_dim d WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, d.d_year, d.d_qoy) a WHERE t.store_sk = a.ss_store_sk(+) AND t.target_year = a.d_year(+) AND t.target_quarter = a.d_qoy(+) AND t.target_year = {year}
SELECT i_category, AVG(margin_pct) AS avg_margin FROM v_item_margin GROUP BY i_category
SELECT i_item_id, profit_margin(i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost) AS margin FROM dim_item WHERE i_category = '{category}' ORDER BY margin DESC FETCH FIRST {n} ROWS ONLY

SELECT d.d_date, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) / MAX(cr.usd_rate) AS revenue_eur FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN currency_rate cr ON cr.rate_date = d.d_date AND cr.currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY d.d_date

SELECT * FROM (SELECT d.d_qoy, i.i_category, ss.ss_net_paid FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk WHERE d.d_year = {year}) PIVOT (SUM(ss_net_paid) FOR d_qoy IN (1 AS q1, 2 AS q2, 3 AS q3, 4 AS q4))

SELECT TO_CHAR(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN TO_DATE('{year}-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('{year}-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(d.d_date, 'YYYY-MM')

SELECT d.d_date, SUM(SUM(ws.ws_net_profit)) OVER (ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_profit FROM web_sales ws JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = {year} GROUP BY d.d_date
SELECT ADD_MONTHS(DATE '{year}-01-01', LEVEL - 1) AS month_start FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12
SELECT c.c_customer_id, NVL(ca.ca_state, 'UNKNOWN') AS state FROM customer c, customer_address ca WHERE c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk(+) AND c.c_birth_year > {birth_year}

SELECT DECODE(p.p_channel_email, 'Y', 'EMAIL', 'N', 'OTHER', 'UNKNOWN') AS channel, COUNT(*) AS sales FROM store_sales ss, promotion p WHERE ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk GROUP BY DECODE(p.p_channel_email, 'Y', 'EMAIL', 'N', 'OTHER', 'UNKNOWN')

SELECT LEVEL AS depth, LPAD(' ', 2 * (LEVEL - 1)) || full_name AS employee, SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(employee_id, '/') AS path FROM employee START WITH manager_id IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR employee_id = manager_id ORDER SIBLINGS BY full_name
SELECT e.employee_id, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, e.hire_date) / 12) AS years FROM employee e JOIN department dp ON e.department_id = dp.department_id WHERE dp.department_name = 'Department {dept}'

SELECT ca.ca_state, LISTAGG(c.c_last_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.c_last_name) AS names FROM customer c JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE ca.ca_state = '{state}' AND ROWNUM <= 50 GROUP BY ca.ca_state
SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk FROM web_sales MINUS SELECT ss_customer_sk FROM store_sales

SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, COUNT(*) AS sold, SUM(NVL2(sr.sr_ticket_number, 1, 0)) AS returned FROM store_sales ss, store_returns sr WHERE ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number(+) AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk(+) GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk
SELECT full_name(c_first_name, c_last_name) AS name, age_band(c_birth_year) AS band FROM customer WHERE c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y'
SELECT fmt_customer_name(c_first_name, c_last_name) AS customer_name, c_email_address FROM dim_customer WHERE c_birth_country = '{country}'
SELECT is_weekend(d.d_date) AS weekend, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY is_weekend(d.d_date)
SELECT ss_store_sk, MAX(ss_item_sk) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY ss_net_paid DESC) AS best_item FROM store_sales GROUP BY ss_store_sk
SELECT c_customer_id, c_email_address FROM customer WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(c_email_address, '^[a-z]+\.[a-z]+@', 'i') AND ROWNUM <= {n}
SELECT SUBSTR(c_email_address, INSTR(c_email_address, '@') + 1) AS domain, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customer GROUP BY SUBSTR(c_email_address, INSTR(c_email_address, '@') + 1)

SELECT /*+ PARALLEL(inv, 4) */ w.w_warehouse_name, i.i_item_id, inv.inv_quantity_on_hand FROM inventory inv, warehouse w, item i WHERE inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < {qty}
SELECT i.i_category, i.i_class, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_category, i.i_class)

WITH spend AS (SELECT ss_customer_sk, SUM(ss_net_paid) AS total FROM store_sales GROUP BY ss_customer_sk) SELECT lm.tier, AVG(s.total) AS avg_spend FROM loyalty_member lm JOIN spend s ON lm.customer_sk = s.ss_customer_sk GROUP BY lm.tier

SELECT h.holiday_date, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS revenue FROM holiday_calendar h JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date = h.holiday_date JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY h.holiday_date

SELECT mc.campaign_name, mc.budget, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit FROM marketing_campaign mc JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_promo_sk = mc.campaign_id WHERE mc.uses_email = 'Y' GROUP BY mc.campaign_name, mc.budget

SELECT s.supplier_name, COUNT(*) AS items, MIN(ph.price) AS min_price FROM supplier s JOIN item i ON i.i_manufact_id = s.supplier_id JOIN price_history ph ON ph.item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY s.supplier_name

SELECT ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customer c, household_demographics hd, income_band ib WHERE c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk AND hd.hd_income_band_sk = ib.ib_income_band_sk GROUP BY ib.ib_lower_bound, ib.ib_upper_bound

SELECT DECODE(cd.cd_gender, 'M', 'Male', 'F', 'Female') AS gender, cd.cd_education_status, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customer c JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_education_status

SELECT cc.cc_name, cp.cp_catalog_page_number, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales cs, call_center cc, catalog_page cp WHERE cs.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk AND cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_name, cp.cp_catalog_page_number

SELECT web.web_name, sm.sm_type, wp.wp_type, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM web_sales ws, web_site web, ship_mode sm, web_page wp WHERE ws.ws_web_site_sk = web.web_site_sk AND ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk AND ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY web.web_name, sm.sm_type, wp.wp_type

SELECT r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS returns, SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS amount FROM web_returns wr LEFT JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc UNION ALL SELECT r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*), SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns cr LEFT JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO stg_store_sales SELECT * FROM store_sales WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = (SELECT MAX(ss_sold_date_sk) FROM store_sales)
INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO stg_web_sales SELECT * FROM web_sales WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = (SELECT MAX(ws_sold_date_sk) FROM web_sales)
INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO stg_catalog_sales SELECT * FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_sold_date_sk = (SELECT MAX(cs_sold_date_sk) FROM catalog_sales)
INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO stg_store_returns SELECT * FROM store_returns WHERE sr_returned_date_sk = (SELECT MAX(sr_returned_date_sk) FROM store_returns)
INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO stg_web_returns SELECT * FROM web_returns WHERE wr_returned_date_sk = (SELECT MAX(wr_returned_date_sk) FROM web_returns)
INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO stg_catalog_returns SELECT * FROM catalog_returns WHERE cr_returned_date_sk = (SELECT MAX(cr_returned_date_sk) FROM catalog_returns)
INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO stg_inventory SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE inv_date_sk = (SELECT MAX(inv_date_sk) FROM inventory)

MERGE INTO dim_customer t USING customer s ON (t.c_customer_sk = s.c_customer_sk) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.c_email_address = s.c_email_address, t.c_current_addr_sk = s.c_current_addr_sk WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (c_customer_sk, c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name) VALUES (s.c_customer_sk, s.c_customer_id, s.c_first_name, s.c_last_name)

MERGE INTO dim_item t USING item s ON (t.i_item_sk = s.i_item_sk) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.i_current_price = s.i_current_price WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_current_price) VALUES (s.i_item_sk, s.i_item_id, s.i_current_price)
INSERT /*+ APPEND */ INTO dim_date SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date_sk NOT IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM dim_date)
UPDATE dim_store t SET t.s_manager = (SELECT s.s_manager FROM store s WHERE s.s_store_sk = t.s_store_sk)
SELECT run_id, run_date FROM etl_run_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND run_date > SYSDATE - {days}
SELECT * FROM store_sales
SELECT c.c_customer_id, cd.cd_credit_rating FROM customer c, customer_demographics cd WHERE c.c_birth_year = {birth_year}
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(ss_net_paid) FROM store_sales
